msg: requirements crit. 2: RL >= 26 dB at 25.0 MHz. Nominal build (R=50.0, L=6.9nH), trimmer at its best 25 MHz setting. Measured 72.58 dB.

wrong-value tripwire: the nominal build must be FAR better than spec (72.6 dB). A reading near 26-40 dB means L_launch, C_pad or the trimmer setting is wrong, not that the design is marginal. 40 dB is deliberately below the 44 dB a bottomed-out 3 pF-minimum trimmer would give, so a part re-selection cannot fail this.
requirements crit. 3: RL >= 20 dB over 22.5-27.5 MHz at the SAME fixed trimmer setting (worst point in band). Measured 70.93 dB.
crit. 2 at the select-on-test upper limit R=51.0 ohm (P1 +/-2% inspection window). Measured 39.89 dB.
crit. 3 at R=51.0 ohm, trimmer fixed at its 25 MHz setting. Measured 39.85 dB.

THE BINDING ASSERTION: crit. 2 at the worst build - catalogue +5% resistance (52.5 ohm, T50R0-250-12X datasheet tolerance) AND the pessimistic launch inductance (8.4 nH, blocks.md s8 OPEN-5). Measured 32.14 dB = 6.14 dB of margin.
crit. 3 at the worst build, trimmer tuned once at 25.0 MHz and left alone. Measured 32.12 dB.
band lower edge 22.5 MHz, worst build. Measured 32.17 dB.
band upper edge 27.5 MHz, worst build (the worse of the two edges - X rises with f). Measured 32.12 dB.
the best 25 MHz setting must exist inside the swept trimmer range (1-35 pF). Nominal build needs 1.459 pF of trimmer on top of the 1.3 pF pad parasitic.
best setting at the worst build: 1.746 pF.
informational: 20 dB also holds over the whole swept 20-30 MHz, wider than the 22.5-27.5 MHz spec band. Nominal 69.42 dB.

20-30 MHz at the worst build: 32.10 dB. The band response is essentially flat because X = wL is only 1.3 ohm - the frequency dependence of this one-port is negligible next to its resistance tolerance.
